topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I found out today that someone got a tattoo of my artwork. It’s an odd feeling, seeing something so personal transformed onto someone’s skin, as permanent as it is personal. I can’t help but wonder about the story behind it. Was it a tribute, or did it hold some deeper, personal meaning? I should probably feel flattered, but all I can think about is the weight of that decision. I’ve been mulling over whether I should reach out, maybe to thank them, or perhaps to understand. It’s a lot to process.
